about: Labelled single-fact cases for ontomark-ingest. Every quote occurs verbatim in its note and names an existing vocabulary term, so each is syntactically groundable; `supported` says whether the quote actually states the fact. Categories other than affirmative, paraphrase and the positive half of paired are adversarial: the words are present but the fact is not asserted.

cases.subject: Wolf
cases.body: The Wolf is a Mammal that hunts in packs.

cases.subject: Eagle
cases.body: An Eagle is a Bird of prey with keen eyesight.

cases.subject: Salmon
cases.body: The Salmon is a Fish that returns to its home river to spawn.

cases.subject: Oak
cases.body: The Oak is a Tree with lobed leaves.

cases.subject: Violin
cases.body: The Violin is an Instrument played with a bow.

cases.subject: France
cases.body: France is part of Europe.

cases.subject: Earth
cases.body: The Earth is part of the Solar System.

cases.subject: Acme

cases.subject: Oxfam
cases.body: Oxfam is a Charity that works on poverty.

cases.subject: Crankshaft

cases.subject: Fox

cases.subject: Newland

cases.quote: listed the bat as a Bird
